description.en:
The parameter type. Valid values:

- **normal**: not encrypted.
- **md5**: MD5-encrypted.

description.zh:
车牌号
> 
> - 当paramType取值normal时，输入明文。
> - 当paramType取值md5时，输入车牌号除最后两位的其他部分明文+车牌最后两位字母MD5加密（32位小写MD5）
description.en:
The license plate number.
> 
> - If ParamType is set to normal, enter the plaintext value.
> - If ParamType is set to md5, enter the plaintext of the license plate number excluding the last two characters, concatenated with the MD5-encrypted value of the last two characters (32-bit lowercase MD5).
The vehicle type on the driving license.

description.zh:
车辆识别代码，即车辆VIN码


> 
> - 当paramType取值normal时，输入明文。
> - 当paramType取值md5时，输入VIN码除后4位的其他部分明文+VIN码后4位MD5加密（32位小写MD5）
description.en:
The vehicle identification number (VIN).


> 
> - If ParamType is set to normal, enter the plaintext value.
> - If ParamType is set to md5, enter the plaintext of the VIN excluding the last 4 characters, concatenated with the MD5-encrypted value of the last 4 characters (32-bit lowercase MD5).

descriptions.zh: 通过车牌号、车辆类型、车辆识别码（vin），查询车辆投保日期
descriptions.en: Queries the insurance date of a vehicle by license plate number, vehicle type, and vehicle identification number (VIN).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth vehicle-insure-query --param-type normal --vehicle-type 02 --vehicle-num '陕A90000' --vin LB00000000000000 --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth VehicleInsureQuery --region cn-hangzhou --VehicleType 02 --Vin LB00000000000000 --ParamType normal --VehicleNum '陕A90000'
